columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the custodian account id in the declaration's account form (10-char zero-padded)

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: the TRADING day (lib/trading_calendar.py), the performance axis

columns.name: beginning_value
columns.meaning: V_(t-1) -- the served producer's whole-account value (C-VALUE) at the prior trading day's close; null on NO_PRIOR_VALUE

columns.name: contributions
columns.meaning: capital in over the interval: the sum of the positive custodian-day NET external flows the interval folds in (the skipped-day rule). A day with both a deposit and a withdrawal nets within the day, because the served classifier returns the net per account-day and never the legs

columns.name: withdrawals
columns.meaning: capital out over the interval, as a non-negative amount: the negated sum of the negative custodian-day net external flows

columns.name: realized
columns.meaning: the summed realized gain (proceeds less cost_basis_unamortized) of the lots closed on the custodian days the interval folds in; null with a coverage reason where the lot source is absent

columns.name: unrealized_change
columns.meaning: the change in the summed unrealized gain of the open lots between the prior trading day and this one; a lot sold in the interval leaves the unrealized book at its gain, so realized + unrealized_change is each lot's interval gain once; null with a coverage reason where a lot partition is absent

columns.name: income
columns.meaning: income recognised on CASH RECEIPT over the same interval as the flow terms -- the served producer's income_received, unchanged

columns.name: ending_value
columns.meaning: V_t -- the served producer's whole-account value at this trading day's close, cash included

columns.name: identity_gap
columns.meaning: beginning_value + contributions - withdrawals + realized + unrealized_change + income - ending_value, never plugged into any term; null where the identity cannot be graded

columns.name: rounding_allowance
columns.meaning: the gap the sources' own 2 dp carry can account for: 0.005 x (lots on this day + lots on the prior day + 4) + 0.01 x the realized lots in the interval; null where identity_gap is

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the method this figure was produced under (1)

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: whether the identity is graded on this row and how it came out; the value that says why a lot column is null

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: domain: 'can the activity identity be graded on this account-day, and did it agree'. NO_LOTS (the firm's source carries no lot tables; the lot columns are null, the PRD's own reason) | NO_PRIOR_VALUE (the custodian has no value for the prior trading day, so there is no beginning) | LOT_PARTITION_ABSENT (a lot partition the interval needs has not landed) | MEASURED (every term present and the gap is inside the rounding allowance) | GAP_ABOVE_ALLOWANCE (every term present and the gap is outside it). COVERED BY SUBTRACTION: an emitted row's firm either has lot tables or not; with them it either has a prior value or not; with one it either has every lot partition the interval needs or not; with all of them the gap is either inside the allowance or outside it. Four binary questions, five members, none left over. Precedence is the order in the producer's ACTIVITY_COVERAGE.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: Every member is an ACCOUNT-DAY property. rounding_allowance and identity_gap are account-day figures; no member speaks of an account or a lot.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: coverage answers ONE question -- whether the identity was graded and how it came out -- and nothing else. It does not say how good the return is (account_return_daily.day_quality), whether a flow was classified (the served guard_state), or which lot a number came from.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. Landing a late lot partition moves LOT_PARTITION_ABSENT only. A firm that gains lot tables moves NO_LOTS only. An account's first day moves NO_PRIOR_VALUE and nothing else. GAP_ABOVE_ALLOWANCE is moved by none of these: it reports a difference between the custodian's value and the sum of its own lots, flows and income that no coverage remedy removes (value held outside the lot tables, or a flow the classifier books against the wrong account-day).

firm_specific_columns: NONE. No Schwab code survives into this table (no tr_cd, sb_cd, h_t, l_s, close_event_id column); the custodian's lot-table and column names live only in the producer's LOT_SOURCE adapter block, which row IRPT_DASHBD-W20-S1 asks to move into sources.json.

limits_of_method_version_1: method_version 1: contributions and withdrawals are the sign split of the per-custodian-day NET flow (a day carrying both nets within the day); income is cash-receipt (the served producer's); fees, margin interest and any value held outside the lot tables are NOT terms, so they appear as identity_gap and are never plugged into a term; the lot tables are the custodian's, so an account whose value sits outside them grades GAP_ABOVE_ALLOWANCE rather than MEASURED.
